turns.text: I reported a scrape on the print, and your reply said it was part of the artwork. It's a raised scratch across the ink. I'd like to dispute that decision.
I’m sorry your initial report was dismissed. I’ve passed your dispute to a colleague, who will take over and review the decision. I’ve noted that you described a raised scratch across the ink.

input.summary: Customer disputes the prior decision that the reported scrape was part of the artwork. They describe a raised scratch across the ink and want the damage decision reviewed. Order number and email have not been provided.
